Is it possible to generate a bar chart for a spreadsheet file using system software? Explain briefly. No. System software is used to control the hardware operation and manage system resources. For editing spreadsheet files, we should use application software.Ken wants to install a video game of size 24 GB on his computer. However, there is unused storage space of 8 GB in his computer. After running a defragmentation software on his computer, there is still not enough storage space to install the video game. Why? Defragmentation is used for regrouping the data fragments in storage to increase the data access rate. It rarely frees up a storage space of over 16 GB as result.263.1

Mode of Operation323.4Different computers have different modes of operation. These modes can be categorised by when to process and how to process. They include:Batch processingReal-time processingParallel processingDistributed processingVirtualisation

Batch processing33AA batch processing system collects data without immediately processing it. Instead, data is processed in a batch at regular intervals. Its advantages include:Making good use of idling system resourcesProcessing a large volume of similar data in one goRelatively less expensive to operate and set up

Real-time processing34BA real-time processing system processes data as soon as the data is received.It allows users to get immediate responses that are up-to-date. However, it requires large computing power and main memory to keep its response time short.

Parallel processing35CA parallel processing system usually consists of multiple processors and memory can be shared among these processors.The system may:Assign a task for each processor so that multiple tasks are performed concurrently to achieve multitaskingDivide a task into multiple portions and assign a portion for each processor so that every portion is performed concurrently

Distributed processing36DA distributed processing system consists of a high-speed network and multiple computers. A program or a computer is used to manage the interaction between these computers. Here are the two characteristics of this system:Has high scalabilityCan achieve multitasking

Virtualisation37EVirtualisation divides the computer hardware into multiple virtual portions with the help of utility programs to create a virtual machine.The virtual machine can:run an operating system different from the original computerinstall software that is not compatible with the operating system of the original computer.

Which of the following statement about modes of operations are correct?Distributed processing requires network connectivity.Batch processing does not process data once the data is received.Parallel processing can divide a task into multiple subtasks and assign them to different computers to process concurrently.(1) and (2) only(1) and (3) only(2) and (3) only(1), (2) and (3)383.2

AnalysisFor item (1), distributed processing assigns tasks or subtasks to different computers with the help of a network. Therefore, network connectivity is a must for distributed processing.For item (2), batch processing processes data in a batch at regular intervals, instead of processing immediately after the data is received.For item (3), parallel processing assigns tasks or subtasks to different processors, not computers.SolutionThe answer is A.393.2

AnalysisTo create a virtual machine, Owen needs a utility program to divide the computer hardware into multiple virtual portions. After that, he needs to install a mobile OS on his computer. Application software is not needed.SolutionThe answer is C.413.2

Cindy wants to create an online ticket system for her cinema. Which systems would you suggest, batch processing system or real-time processing system? Explain briefly.Real-time processing system. Customers need to know which seats are available (or whether there are available seats) when deciding which tickets to buy (or whether to buy tickets or not). Therefore, the system must update immediately after each successful transaction, otherwise, the ticket of a seat may be bought by multiple customers (or there may not be enough seats for all customers that have bought tickets).423.2

Every day, people put letters into a post-box. At 6 o’clock, a postman collects all the letters from the post-box and immediately delivers every letter to its target locations. Which mode of operation, batch processing or real-time processing, is the closest description to the postman’s job? Explain briefly.Batch processing. The postman does not deliver every letter as soon as it is dropped into the post-box. They only deliver the letters at a regular time interval.433.2
